derivation: from H1984 (הָלַל) (in the sense of rejoicing);
def: a celebration of thanksgiving for harvest

occurrences.text: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the Lord withal.
And they went out into the fields, and gathered their vineyards, and trode the grapes, and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
